production.note: US model years. Excellence's 928 S4 spec pages run from "1987 928 S4" to "1991 928 S4" (excellence-1991-928-s4). The 928 GT and 928 GTS are separate cars.

body.note: Edmunds 1991: only style "2dr Coupe" (a hatchback coupe).

transmission.note: "Options 4-speed automatic, 5-speed manual". The owner's manual data lists "Manual transmission G 28/13" and "Automatic transmission A 28/12" (porsche-1987-928-s4-manual). Excellence's 1991 S4 page lists only "Options 4-speed automatic" (excellence-1991-928-s4).

powerHp.note: US SAE net rating. Quote (Porsche 928 S4 Owner's Manual technical data, Model Year 1987, as reproduced): "SAE net-horsepower SAE J 1349 | 316 hp / 235 kW at 6000 rpm". Edmunds 1991 2dr Coupe: "316 hp @ 6,000 rpm" (edmunds-1991-928, database). Excellence prints "Horsepower 320 @ 6000 rpm" (excellence-1987-928-s4), the 235 kW figure in DIN PS; the US rating is 316 hp.

weightLb.note: 1987 coupe, 5-speed manual. Quote (owner's manual technical data, as reproduced): "Curb weight1 | 3505 lbs / 1590 kg", footnote "1 Automatic 3549 lbs / 1610 kg". Excellence agrees: "Curb Weight 3,505 lbs. manual/3,549 lbs. automatic" (excellence-1987-928-s4); Edmunds 1991: "3,505 lbs." (edmunds-1991-928). Confidence is medium rather than high because the owner's manual is known only through an enthusiast's retyped transcription; Excellence (3,505 manual / 3,549 automatic) and Edmunds (316 hp, 3,505 lb) agree with it exactly, which makes a transcription error unlikely.

sources.publisher: Porsche (928 S4 Owner's Manual technical data, reproduced by John Pirtle on Rennlist)
sources.title: Model Year 1987 (Porsche 928 S4 Owner's Manual, Technical Data)

discrepancies.reason: Rating standard: 316 hp is the SAE J1349 net rating in Porsche's owner's manual; 320 is the same 235 kW expressed in metric (DIN) horsepower.
discrepancies.resolution: Used the US SAE net rating, 316 hp (also Edmunds 1991).
